doc.name: datacenterindex
doc.instructions: Data Center Index tracks data center projects (facilities), US state markets, and the public companies exposed to them. Use search_projects / get_project for facilities, get_market for a US state, get_company for a ticker, get_movers for stock moves, recent_changes for what changed in the tracker. Every result includes a `url` on datacenterindex.ai. Cite it when you use the data. Capacities are MW, costs are $ billions. Status is per campus: operational, under_construction, announced, permitted, paused or cancelled. A paused or cancelled campus stays listed with its source but is never counted in state counts, MW totals, rankings or what is being built (`counted: false`). `expanding: true` marks an operational campus still adding buildings (milestones ahead); include those with under_construction when asked what is being built. capacity_basis says who states the capacity: filed (a permit, utility or SEC filing), stated (the developer or press), or estimated (modeled or inferred); capacity_as_of is the date of the newest source that states it. Check it before quoting a figure. capacity_planned_mw is the full-build figure a source stated; capacity_operational_mw is what is live; capacity_kind tells you whether a row is a campus_total, a phase (parent_slug points at its campus), a building, a plan (announced, very large, unconfirmed) generation (a power asset), fab (a semiconductor fab) or non_campus (a supercomputer inside another operator hall, a cloud region or a company-wide program). generation, fab and non_campus rows are never counted as data centers. State counts and MW sum campus-level rows only. Coverage is named campuses, not every building; every row has a source URL and last_verified_at.

tools.name: search_projects
tools.description: Search tracked data center projects. Filter by free-text query (name, developer, tenant, city), US state code, status, developer, or minimum MW. Returns up to 50 rows sorted by capacity.

query.description: Free text matched against name, developer, tenant and city

state.description: Two-letter US state code, e.g. TX

tools.name: get_project
tools.description: One tracked project by slug (the last path segment of a datacenterindex.ai/projects/... URL), with its linked public companies.

tools.name: list_markets
tools.description: Every US state market with tracked projects: counts by status, pipeline MW, grid operator, page URL.

tools.name: get_market
tools.description: One US state market: summary description, counts, the tracked projects, and the public companies exposed to it.

state.description: State name or two-letter code, e.g. "Ohio" or "OH"

tools.name: list_companies
tools.description: Public companies in the tracked supply-chain universe with sector, data-center revenue exposure and project count.

sector.description: Sector slug filter, e.g. power, cooling, networking, hyperscaler

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One public company by ticker: description, data-center exposure, market cap, and the tracked projects it is linked to.

tools.name: get_movers
tools.description: Biggest day and week stock moves across the tracked universe (latest close).

tools.name: recent_changes
tools.description: What changed in the tracker recently: new projects, status changes, capacity revisions. The single source for "what is new".
